comment: ANCHOR: WATCHLIST_FILTERS_COMPACT_20261104 — FQ-077: at phone width the filter stack collapses to one line naming how many filters are active (or that none are), so the first result is not several screens down; every filter is still present behind the toggle and desktop keeps them inline.
